settings.question: Can I buy gifts online?
settings.answer: No — ShaadiGifts is a gifting concierge, not an online shop. Browse the collections, add favourites to your wishlist and submit your wedding details. We will send a personalised proposal.

settings.question: How does the wishlist work?
settings.answer: Tap the heart on any gift to save it. Add your quantities and notes, then share the selection with your wedding details to request a personalised quote. Nothing is charged and there is no checkout.

settings.question: Are the prices final?
settings.answer: Prices shown are indicative starting prices. Your final quotation depends on quantity, personalisation and packaging.

settings.question: Can you personalise gifts with our names and theme?
settings.answer: Yes. We can add names, monograms, custom tags and message cards, and match packaging to your wedding colours and theme.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside India?
settings.answer: Yes. We serve Indian and international weddings and deliver to your venue, hotel or home. Tell us the country and city in the planner and we will confirm the details.

settings.question: How early should I start planning?
settings.answer: As early as you can. Personalised and carefully packed gifts need time. Share your wedding date and requirements in the planner and we will advise on timelines.
